evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>

sources_quoted.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste. — Ability Haste: 10 / 20 / 30

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts). With c_i the effective cooldown of ability i, the cast epochs of a solo ability are 0, c_i, 2c_i, ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.
Ability haste (effective_cooldown) | cd' = cd*100/(100+AH) ... | EXACT | R casts exactly once per timed fight (model constraint, documented)
A resource (internal index 12) consumed by specific actions, shown as pips or icons below the health bar: ... stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)

E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres). All five slots modeled with sourced numbers.

at_zero_item_haste.Q_Dark_Sphere: 7 * 100 / (100 + 30 R-passive AH) = 5.3846 s (5.3846 s per stocked charge)
at_zero_item_haste.R_Unleashed_Power: 80 s, and the engine casts R exactly once per timed fight

step_2_Q_strictly_beats_W_for_every_hast.claim: cd'_Q < cd'_W for all item haste H >= 0 and all rank pairings
step_2_Q_strictly_beats_W_for_every_hast.without_R_passive: 700/(100+H) < 800/(100+H) trivially; at W ranks 1-4 (12/11/10/9 s) the margin only widens
step_2_Q_strictly_beats_W_for_every_hast.corollary: Whenever Q and W are both started at the fight opener, Q always becomes available again strictly before W. There is no rank, no item-haste value, and no wiki-sourced mechanic under which Force of Will recurs ahead of Dark Sphere.

step_3_opener_and_the_sixth_cast.opener: Dark Sphere is a stocked (ammo) cast holding up to 2 charges once Syndra has 40+ Splinters of Wrath, which the cached module evidence records as the modeled default (splinters 120 -> Q2 slot live). The opener therefore spends 5 casts: Q, Q (second charge), W, E, R at t = 0, 0, 0, 0.25, 0.50 s (Q and W castTime 'none'; E and R castTime 0.25 s) -> cast_timeline[0..4].
step_3_opener_and_the_sixth_cast.next_event: cast_timeline[5] is the first post-opener recast; candidate epochs are Q recharge t = 5.385 s, W recast t = 8.000 s, E recast t = 0.25 + 15 = 15.25 s, R never again (single-cast constraint).
step_3_opener_and_the_sixth_cast.robustness: The only parameterisation that yields Force of Will at index 5 is a 4-cast opener with no second Q charge (Q,W,E,R then Q@cd_Q at index 4, W@cd_W at index 5). That requires Splinters < 40, contradicting the cached Transcendent modelling, and even then two Q casts can never precede one W cast (2*cd'_Q < cd'_W is false for every H, verified numerically above), so the timeline is Q-dense either way.

step_4_sixty_second_sanity_check.cast_counts_over_60_s_at_zero_item_haste: Q ~13 (5.385 s per charge, 2 stocked), W 8 (8 s), E 5 (15 s), R 1 (single-cast constraint)
step_4_sixty_second_sanity_check.reading: Dark Sphere is by a wide margin the most frequent cast in a 60 s Syndra timeline; a timeline whose sixth entry is Force of Will under-represents Q relative to the sourced cooldowns.

caveats: The scenario's own input tuple (its explicit custom cast_order, level, item haste, splinter option) lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/, src/, tests/), so it was not read. The derivation above is therefore parameter-free where it matters: Q's effective cooldown is strictly shorter than W's for every rank and every ability-haste value, so any cooldown-gated shared-timeline schedule puts Dark Sphere, not Force of Will, at the first post-opener recast slot.

If cast_timeline were a literal, non-cooldown-gated cycling of a user-supplied order, index 5 would mirror index 1; the reported change touches index 5 alone, which is inconsistent with pure cycling and consistent with cooldown-gated scheduling as documented in docs/math-foundations.md Sec. 1.1.
conclusion: Independently derived value for fights/manual_target/cast_timeline[5]/name = 'Dark Sphere'. The new value matches; the old value 'Force of Will' is not reachable from the cached cooldowns.
